title: 🔥价格倒挂200日成本15%
body: 市场处于极具赔率的定投舒适区。当前价格 $63,012 低于 200日定投成本 $74,101，倒挂幅度达 -15.0%。新入场资金成本已优于过去半年平均水平，且 AHR999(3D) 为 0.33 处于抄底区。持仓成本下移构筑了坚实底部。偏多。谁在交出底部带血筹码？
body_en: The market is in a prime DCA zone with insane risk/reward. Current price ($63,012) is trading 15.0% below the 200-day DCA average ($74,101). New entries are better than the 6-month average, and AHR999 (3D) sits at 0.33—deep in accumulation territory. Lowering cost basis is constructing a solid floor. Bias: Bullish. Who is capitulating at the bottom?
